title: SSC GD 2026 Final Answer Key, Scorecard released @ssc.gov.in: Check link and steps to download

 News › News News › SSC GD 2026 Final Answer Key, Scorecard released @ssc.gov.in: Check link and steps to download SSC GD 2026 Final Answer Key, Scorecard released @ssc.gov.in: Check link and steps to download
 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Nov 4, 2026, 10:50 IST SSC GD final answer key out SSC GD Answer Key 2026: Staff Selection Commission has released the SSC GD Constable 2026 final answer key, question papers, candidate response sheets, and Computer-Based Examination (CBE) marks/scorecards on the official portal at ssc.gov.in.
 Candidates who appeared for exam can download SSC GD 2026 answer key by visiting official website ssc.gov.in. Candidates can download SSC GD answer key 2026, scorecard, repsonse sheet and question paper using their username and password.
 How to download SSC GD 2026 Answer Key? 
 SSC GD Constable answer key can be downloaded by going through these steps
 Visit official website ssc.gov.in
 Click on login tab, on homepage
 Enter username and password
 Click on Answer Key link and download it
 SSC GD Scorecard 2026 Out 
 The Staff Selection Commission released the SSC GD Scorecard on November 3, 2026. Candidates who appeared for the exam can now download their SSC GD scorecard by November 17, 2026. 
 The Commission has also made the marks available for candidates who appeared in the Computer Based Examination.
 SSC GD Score Card 2026 @ssc.gov.in
 The SSC GD Scorecard is released with answer key. Check all important details given in the table below.
 SSC GD Constable Scorecard and Final Answer Key 2026 
 Exam Name SSC GD Constable Examination 2026 
 Conducting Body Staff Selection Commission 
 Posts Constable (GD) in CAPFs and SSF, Rifleman (GD) in Assam Rifles 
 Exam Mode Computer Based Examination 
 SSC GD Result Date October 12, 2026 
 Final Answer Key Release Date November 3, 2026 
 Score Card Status Released 
 Answer Key Availability November 3 to 17, 2026 
 Last Date to Download November 17, 2026 (5:00 PM) 
 Login Credentials Roll Number and Password / Registered ID and Password 
 Official Website ssc.gov.in 
 SSC GD Scorecard 2026 Download Link 
 The SSC GD Final Answer Key 2026 download link is activated on the official website. Candidates can login with their Roll Number and Password to download the final answer key, question paper and response sheet. 
 The Commission has also uploaded the marks of candidates who appeared in the Computer Based Examination. Candidates can check their SSC GD Scorecard by logging in with their Registered ID and Password. Candidates should download and save their respective documents before November 17, 2026. The direct link to download the SSC GD Scorecard 2026 PDF is provided below:
 SSC GD Final Answer Key 2026: Click to Download 
 Steps to Download SSC GD Score Card 2026 
 The SSC GD Score Card 2026 is out on official website. Candidates can check their marks they scored in the written exam.
 Open the official website of the Staff Selection Commission.
 Go to login section for checking SSC GD marks.
 Enter the Registered ID and Password.
 Submit the login details.
 Your SSC GD Score Card 2026 will appear on the screen.
 Check the marks and other details.
 Download and save the scorecard for future.
 SSC GD Score Card 2026 - Details mentioned 
 The SSC GD Score Card 2026 shares the marks scored by candidates in the Computer Based Examination. Candidates should check their scorecard properly after downloading it. The following details can be checked in the PDF.
 Candidate’s Name
 Roll Number
 Registered ID
 Examination Name
 Marks Obtained
 Examination Details
